name: Coolant Heads Prevail
summary: Lotwil Veriatus needs Frost Oil for the shackles holding his summoned friend. Bro'kin, Lotwil's goblin friend in Alterac, can teach you to make it.

sections.title: A Vital Coolant
sections.body: Lotwil Veriatus says Frost Oil keeps engines and gears from overheating. He calls it an unmatched lubricant. It also helps magical items hold their enchantments. The oil could strengthen Lotwil's shackles enough to stop his summoned friend from killing everyone.

sections.title: Bro'kin of Alterac
sections.body: Bro'kin, Lotwil's goblin friend, can teach you to make Frost Oil. He sells from a spot on the old city's wall in the Ruins of Alterac.

sections.title: When the Oil Arrives
sections.body: When the oil arrives, Lotwil calls it the perfect coolant for the new bracers. He swears that if the enchantments do not last a century, all his belongings will go to Servo. Lotwil expects the mages of the Assembly to be in awe when the work is finished.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil Veriatus need Frost Oil?
faq.answer: Frost Oil would strengthen Lotwil Veriatus's shackles enough to stop his summoned friend from killing everyone.

faq.q: Who knows how to brew Frost Oil?
faq.answer: Bro'kin, Lotwil Veriatus's goblin friend, can teach you to make Frost Oil. He sells from a spot on the old city's wall in the Ruins of Alterac.

faq.q: What is special about Frost Oil?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus says Frost Oil keeps engines and gears from overheating. He calls it an unmatched lubricant, and says it helps magical items hold their enchantments.
